summary.result: Then, the modified scheme is employed to simulate tsunami propagation on variable water depths and numerical results are compared with those of the previous tsunami propagation model.
summary.background: In this study, a modified dispersion-correction scheme describing tsunami propagation on variable water depths is proposed by introducing additional terms to the previous numerical scheme.
summary.method: The numerical dispersion of the proposed model replaces the physical dispersion of the governing equations.
